branch_selection: Ordered source games, then decision order: first disagreements per family, at most one selected point per game. A point may cover several families. Retain every selected alternative regardless of factual or branch outcome. Maximum84 unique branches; report shortfalls without extra sampling.
branch_intervention: Replace only the selected learner action by the frozen tactical recommendation. Original opponent action and simulator prefix stay fixed. Thereafter use original frozen learner and opponent, with action counters continued. One realized conditional chance path; not expected regret, oracle optimality or population causal effect. Rejected advertised actions remain attempts.
training_policy: same-seed F10 rehearsal final checkpoint versus tactical-v1; alternate learner seat; swap=false; fresh official train partition only
scenario_selection: Ordered fresh train games then decisions; first tagged disagreements per family, at most one point per game. Same point may cover multiple families. Select before the current action, without conditioning on future outcome. At most84 starts; report shortfalls. Prefix decisions are never learner training rows.
curriculum_use: Executable reset to an unsolved train decision, then normal complete-battle continuation. No heuristic imitation labels or dev states copied into training. Future matched-budget curriculum versus official-start training comparison must be registered separately.
curriculum_weights: Adaptive development recipe: each family has weight1 plus count of selected branches carrying that family with positive natural-terminal reward delta; normalize over all7. These conditional-path counts are not expected regret. Proposed prefix fractions10%,20%,25%, rest fresh official starts; no updates executed.
